title_en: The call-up came, I must go as a soldier
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional soldier's farewell song, origin unclear. 'је' in 'је реков' is dialect for 'ѝ' (to her), my reading; 'Ленче бре' is an address to a name (Lenche).

lines.en: The call-up came for me too

lines.cyr: позив дојде и за мене, Ленче бре
lines.lat: poziv dojde i za mene, Lenče bre
lines.en: the call-up came for me too, Lenche hey
and I must go as a soldier.
All my relatives around me,

lines.cyr: сета рода покрај мене, Ленче бре
lines.lat: seta roda pokraj mene, Lenče bre
lines.en: all my relatives around me, Lenche hey
see me off with joy.
Only my faithful sweetheart

lines.cyr: само мојто верно либе, Ленче бре
lines.lat: samo mojto verno libe, Lenče bre
lines.en: only my faithful sweetheart, Lenche hey
was not beside me.
She stood at the window

lines.cyr: на пенџере си стоеше, Ленче бре
lines.lat: na pendžere si stoeše, Lenče bre
lines.en: she stood at the window, Lenche hey
shedding small tears.
I said to her and told her

lines.cyr: јас је реков и нареков, Ленче бре:
lines.lat: jas je rekov i narekov, Lenče bre:
lines.en: I said to her and told her, Lenche hey:
- "Hush, sweetheart, do not cry".
Hush, sweetheart, please do not cry

lines.cyr: молчи либе, ај не плачи, Ленче бре
lines.lat: molči libe, aj ne plači, Lenče bre
lines.en: hush, sweetheart, come on, do not cry, Lenche hey
we will see each other soon.

lines.cyr: Бргу ќе се ај видиме, Ленче бре
lines.lat: Brgu ḱe se aj vidime, Lenče bre
lines.en: We will soon, oh, see each other, Lenche hey
we will continue our love.
